862-5006-8095-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
862-5006-8095-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

116-4613-6858.easyPrerequisites:
Oreskos Sun Guide doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Kiora's Follower is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
116-4613-6858.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
116-4613-6858.description:
Activate Oreskos Sun Guide using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Kiora's Follower's ability by tapping it, untapping Oreskos Sun Guide
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

2585-2981-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2585-2981-5660-6769.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Grim Monolith, giving Megatog +3/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Grim Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

751-3286-7175.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

147-3899-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3899-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2896-5145-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
When Archon of Falling Stars dies, it triggers, returning Necromancy from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Necromancy enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Necromancy to it.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
2896-5145-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-4247-6972.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1479-5478-5700-5701-7893.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5478-5700-5701-7893.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
1479-5478-5700-5701-7893.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

64-957-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
64-957-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Warden of the Eye without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Warden of the Eye) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
64-957-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

2034-3755-6970-7175-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

568-1267-7667.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Kenrith's Transformation by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Medomai and causing it to lose its abilities.
When Kenrith's Transformation enters, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Holding priority, cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Kenrith's Transformation and Capsize to your hand.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness
is saddled and doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4478-5500.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-5500.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-4742-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4742-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with The Third Doctor

1409-2397-5422.description:
Activate The Third Doctor by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When The Third Doctor enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and The Third Doctor.
Resolve both The Third Doctor triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1651-1770-4426-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1770-4426-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1770-4426-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Elesh Norn, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

2034-2173-3652-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

4050-4484-6073-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4050-4484-6073-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Angelic Sell-Sword triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token and Ebondeath, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4359-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

4067-6607-6609.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a nonland permanent you control
4067-6607-6609.description:
Activate O'aka by tapping it and removing a counter from a nonland permanent, causing you to draw a card.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a counter on it.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping O'aka.
Repeat.

3586-4222-4720.description:
Activate Magus Lucea Kane by tapping it, adding {2} and causing you to copy the next ability you activate or spell you cast that has {X} in its cost.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Magus Lucea Kane.
Repeat.
Once you have a large number of delayed triggers, cast a spell or activate an ability with {X} in its cost to have Magus Lucea Kane copy that spell or ability infinitely.

1947-3327-4419-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1947-3327-4419-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Renata.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1849-2457-3129-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1018-4377-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Skullwinder each turn.
1018-4377-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Skullwinder by paying its mana cost.
When Skullwinder enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Skullwinder from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1636-2783-5627.notablePrerequisites:
Wight of the Reliquary does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature.
1636-2783-5627.description:
Activate Wight of the Reliquary by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, If the creature was a Dragon Egg, the creature triggers, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Resolve the Wight of the Reliquary ability, causing you to search your library for a land card and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Nesting Dragon triggers, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

643-1185-2577-4346.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional Zombie.
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
643-1185-2577-4346.description:
Activate Gravecrawler by sacrificing itself, causing you to gain three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

539-618-2174.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Juniper Order Druid with haste.
Activate the Juniper Order Druid token by tapping it, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

225-433-539-3861.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Llanowar Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

654-880-2907.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-2907.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger(s), creating that many creature token(s).
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1061-1869-3632.notablePrerequisites: You have the City's Blessing or have at least eight permanents on the battlefield.
1061-1869-3632.description:
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Inalla; pay {1} to make a token copy of Timestream Navigator with haste.
Activate the token Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Erratic Portal by paying {1} and tapping it, returning the original Timestream Navigator to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
